Starts {{shell}} with a script that marks each command, how it ended and the folder it ran in, so you can jump between them. Your profile isn't changed.
Starts {{shell}} with a script that marks each command, how it ended and the folder it ran in, so you can jump between them. Your startup files aren't changed. Only for a server on this computer.
Starts cmd with a prompt that marks each command and the folder it ran in, so you can jump between them. cmd can't say how a command ended. Your own prompt is kept.

rune.storage.checkpoint.description: Another program has OpenCode's saved state open. You're seeing it as of its last checkpoint, which may miss your latest changes. What you change now is lost when OpenCode quits.
rune.storage.damaged.description: OpenCode's saved state was damaged and couldn't be read, so it started with a new one. Your open tabs and drafts from before may be missing. The damaged file is kept at {{path}}.
rune.storage.damaged.title: Started with new saved state
rune.storage.firstRun.description: Another program is holding OpenCode's saved state, so this is a fresh start. Your saved state is untouched. What you change now is lost when OpenCode quits.
rune.storage.memoryOnly.description: OpenCode couldn't open its saved state ({{why}}). What you change now is lost when it quits.
rune.storage.memoryOnly.title: Changes won't be saved
rune.storage.saving.title: Changes are saved again
rune.textRendering.description: How text is drawn, switched live, for comparing renderers. Windfoil draws each glyph's exact coverage from its outline on the GPU, so text stays sharp while it zooms or moves.
rune.textRendering.title: Text rendering
rune.web.connect.title: Connect to an OpenCode server
rune.web.connect.refused: That password didn't work: {{host}} turned down the {{count}}-character password it was sent.
rune.web.connect.unreachable: Couldn't reach that server: check the address, and that the server is running.
rune.web.limits: A preview: the embedded browser, dictation and updates don't work in the browser yet. Sessions you open are the server's own: what you send, rename and delete reaches it.
rune.web.needsJspi: This page needs WebAssembly JS Promise Integration: Chrome or Edge 137, Firefox 153, or Safari 27 (iOS 27) or newer.
rune.web.stay.title: Stay signed in on this device?
rune.web.stay.body: This browser keeps your password for {{server}} on this device, and a Home Screen app you add from here gets it too, so the app opens without asking for it. Anyone who can use this device unlocked can use it. Sign out, in Settings › Server, removes it.
rune.web.connect.notServer: That address answers, but it isn't an OpenCode server: check the address.
rune.web.connect.insecure: This page is on https, and the browser won't let it reach a server on plain http. Use the server's https address.
rune.send.slow: Sending · the server hasn't answered yet · it's kept, and checked if no answer comes
rune.session.slowCopy: This server is slow to answer · showing what was saved
rune.toast.renameNoAnswer: The server didn't confirm the new title in time, so the title it last accepted is back. Try again in a moment.
rune.dictation.timedOut: Dictation didn't finish. The words heard so far are in the draft.
rune.dictation.timedOutEmpty: Dictation didn't finish, and no words were heard. Try again.
rune.web.check.title: Phone check
rune.web.check.intro: Measures this phone and sends only numbers: no password, no screenshot.
rune.web.check.measuring: Measuring. Hold still for a few seconds.
rune.web.check.keyboard: Tap the field. When the keyboard is up, tap Done.
rune.web.check.rotate: Turn the phone sideways, wait two seconds, then turn it back.
rune.storage.notSaving.title: Changes aren't being saved
rune.storage.writeFailed.description: OpenCode couldn't save ({{why}}). What you change stays while it runs, and is saved as soon as it can be.
rune.storage.diskFull.title: The disk is full
rune.storage.diskFull.description: Changes aren't being saved. What you change stays while OpenCode runs, and is saved as soon as there's space. Free some space on this disk.
rune.web.check.signIn: Sign in above. The check goes on after.
